_comment: Choose one runtime and a registered adapter. Replace placeholders with your deployment settings; no provider is selected by default. Credential values stay in Key Vault.

Values.EPP_DECRYPTION_KEY_PEM: <Key Vault secret reference in Azure; PEM or base64 PEM for local development>
Values.EPP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID: <encryption key ID; mismatch gives a nonfatal warning>
Values._comment_auth: Enable Easy Auth on the Function App (unauthenticatedClientAction=Return401, allowedApplications pinned to EPP_EXPECTED_CLIENT_ID) AND set EPP_REQUIRE_AUTH=true in any real deployment. false is for local func start only.
Values.EPP_EXPECTED_AUDIENCE: <endpoint app client-ID GUID for v2 tokens>
Values.EPP_TENANT_ID: <trusted issuer tenant GUID; not the request tenantId>
Values._comment_provider_timeout: Outbound provider HTTP timeout: ASCII decimal milliseconds, default 1500, cap 2500. Not a total invocation deadline; see CONTRACT.md. Provider URLs must be HTTPS; redirects are not followed.
